codeSnippets.output: A scale pulse that loops with animation: pop 0.6s ease infinite;

exercise.instruction: Style the button: add a transition on background and transform (0.3s ease), and on hover change the background to #3a7342 and transform to scale(1.1).
exercise.starterCode:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <title>Animations</title>
  <style>
    .button {
      background: #4f8f57;
      color: white;
      padding: 12px 24px;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 9999px;
      cursor: pointer;

    }
    .button:hover {

    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="button">Hover me</button>
</body>
</html>
